lines: Wild Bill Donovan would have loved the Internet. The American **spymaster** who built the Office of Strategic Services in World War II and later laid the roots for the CIA was fascinated with information. Donovan believed in using whatever tools came to hand in the "great game" of espionage -- spying as a "profession." These days the Net, which has already re-made such everyday pastimes as buying books and sending mail, is reshaping Donovan's vocation as well.
狂热的比尔·多诺汶肯定会爱上互联网。这位曾在第二次世界大战中建立战略情报局、后来又为中央情报局奠定基础的美国谍报大师对情报非常痴迷。多诺汶相信，在谍报活动这场“伟大的游戏”中，可以利用任何到手的工具——间谍活动是一种“职业”。如今，互联网已经改变了买书和寄信这样的日常消遣，也正在改变多诺汶所从事的职业。

lines: The latest revolution isn't simply a matter of gentlemen reading other gentlemen's e-mail. That kind of electronic spying has been going on for decades. In the past three or four years, the World Wide Web has given birth to a whole industry of point-and-click spying. The **spooks** call it "open source intelligence," and as the Net grows, it is becoming increasingly influential. In 1995 the CIA held a contest to see who could compile the most data about Burundi. The winner, by a large margin, was a tiny Virginia company called Open Source Solutions, whose clear advantage was its mastery of the electronic world.

最近的这场革命不仅仅是一个人偷看别人的电子邮件的问题。这样的电子间谍活动已经存在了数十年。在过去的三四年里，万维网已经催生了一个可称为点击谍报的完整产业。间谍们称之为“公开来源情报”，并且随着互联网的发展，它正变得日益具有影响力。1995年，中央情报局举办了一场竞赛，看谁能够收集到关于布隆迪的最多信息。以绝对优势赢得比赛的是弗吉尼亚州一家名为“公开来源解决方案”的小公司，它的明显优势是对电子世界的精通。

lines: Among the firms **making the biggest splash** in this new world is Straitford, Inc., a private intelligence-analysis firm based in Austin, Texas. Straitford makes money by selling the results of spying (covering nations from Chile to Russia) to corporations like energy-services firm McDermott International. Many of its predictions are available online at www.straitford.com.
在这个新领域里引起最大轰动的是司特雷福公司，这是一家总部位于得克萨斯州奥斯汀市的私人情报分析公司。司特雷福通过出售谍报结果（范围涵盖从智利到俄罗斯的国家）给诸如麦克德莫国际公司这样的能源服务公司来赚钱。它的许多预测都可以在www.straitford.com网站上查阅到。

lines: Straitford president George Friedman says he sees the online world as a kind of mutually reinforcing tool for both information collection and distribution, a spymaster's dream. Last week his firm was busy vacuuming up data bits from the far corners of the world and predicting a crisis in Ukraine. "As soon as that report runs, we'll suddenly get 500 new Internet sign-ups from Ukraine," says Friedman, a former political science professor. "And we'll hear back from some of them." Open-source spying does have its risks, of course, since it can be difficult to tell good information from bad. That's where Straitford earns its keep.

司特雷福公司总裁乔治·弗里德曼说，他把网络世界视为情报收集和情报发布相互促进的工具，是谍报大师的梦想。上周，他的公司正忙着从世界的偏僻角落收集零散的信息，并预测乌克兰将发生一场危机。“一旦那篇报道发布，我们将突然获得500个来自乌克兰的新注册用户，”弗里德曼说——他曾任政治学教授。“我们还会从中一些人那里得到反馈。”当然，公开来源的谍报活动确实存在风险，因为很难区分良莠信息。而这正是司特雷福公司谋生立足之本。

lines: Friedman relies on a lean staff of 20 in Austin. Several of his staff members have military-intelligence backgrounds. He sees the firm's **outsider status** as the key to its success. Straitford's briefs don't sound like the usual Washington back-and-forthing, whereby agencies avoid dramatic declarations on the chance they might be wrong. Straitford, says Friedman, takes pride in its **independent voice**.

lines: To paraphrase 18th-century statesman Edmund Burke, "all that is needed for the triumph of a **misguided** cause is that good people do nothing." One such cause now seeks to end biomedical research because of the theory that animals have rights ruling out their use in research. Scientists need to respond forcefully to animal rights advocates, whose arguments are confusing the public and thereby threatening advances in health knowledge and care. Leaders of the animal rights movement target biomedical research because it depends on public funding, and few people understand the process of health care research. Hearing allegations of cruelty to animals in research settings, many are perplexed that anyone would deliberately harm an animal.

借用18世纪政治家埃德蒙·伯克的话说，“要让一项错误的事业得逞，只需要好人无所作为”。现在就有这样一项事业，它试图终止生物医学研究，理由是动物有权拒绝在研究中被使用。科学家必须有力地回应动物权利鼓吹者，因为他们的论点正在混淆公众视听，从而威胁到健康知识与医疗的进步。动物权利运动的领导者之所以把矛头指向生物医学研究，是因为它依赖公共拨款，而很少有人了解医疗保健研究的过程。听到在研究环境中虐待动物的说法，许多人不明白竟有人会故意伤害动物。

lines: For example, a **grandmotherly** woman staffing an animal rights booth at a recent street fair was distributing a brochure that encouraged readers not to use anything that comes from or is tested in animals -- no meat, no fur, no medicines. Asked if she opposed immunizations, she wanted to know if vaccines come from animal research. When assured that they do, she replied, "Then I would have to say yes." Asked what will happen when epidemics return, she said, "Don't worry, scientists will find some way of using computers." Such well-meaning people just don't understand.

例如，在最近的一次街头集市上，一位在动物权利宣传点服务的慈祥老妇人散发小册子，鼓励读者不要使用任何来自动物或在动物身上试验过的东西——不吃肉，不穿皮毛，不吃药。当被问到是否反对免疫接种时，她想知道疫苗是否来自动物研究。当确信疫苗确实来自动物研究时，她回答说：“那么我不得不说，是的，我反对。”当被问到如果瘟疫卷土重来怎么办时，她说：“不用担心，科学家会找到用计算机来解决的办法。”这样的好心人就是不了解情况。

lines: Scientists must communicate their message to the public in a compassionate, understandable way -- in human terms, not in the language of molecular biology. We need to make clear the connection between animal research and a grandmother's hip replacement, a father's bypass operation, a baby's vaccinations, and even a pet's shots. To those who are unaware that animal research was needed to produce these treatments, as well as new treatments and vaccines, animal research seems wasteful at best and cruel at worst.

lines: It is said that in England death is pressing, in Canada inevitable and in California optional. Small wonder. Americans' life expectancy has nearly doubled over the past century. Failing hips can be replaced, clinical depression controlled, cataracts removed in a 30-minute surgical procedure. Such advances offer the aging population a quality of life that was unimaginable when I entered medicine 50 years ago. But not even a great health-care system can cure death -- and our failure to confront that reality now threatens this greatness of ours.
据说，在英国死亡是迫在眉睫的，在加拿大死亡是不可避免的，而在加利福尼亚死亡则是可以选择的。这并不奇怪。过去一个世纪里，美国人的寿命几乎延长了一倍。髋骨坏了可以更换，临床抑郁症可以控制，白内障只需30分钟的手术便可摘除。这种进步为老年人提供了50年前我行医时难以想象的生活质量。但是再伟大的医疗体系也无法治愈死亡——而我们不能正视这一现实，如今正在危及我们自身的伟大。

lines: Death is normal; we are genetically programmed to disintegrate and perish, even under ideal conditions. We all understand that at some level, yet as medical consumers we treat death as a problem to be solved. Shielded by third-party payers from the cost of our care, we demand everything that can possibly be done for us, even if it's useless. The most obvious example is late-stage cancer care. Physicians -- frustrated by their inability to cure the disease and fearing loss of hope in the patient -- too often offer **aggressive** treatment far beyond what is scientifically justified.
死亡是正常的；我们的基因决定我们即使在最理想的条件下也会解体和消亡。我们在某种程度上都明白这一点，然而作为医疗消费者，我们却把死亡视为一个有待解决的问题。由于有第三方支付我们的医疗费用，我们便要求为我们做一切可能做到的事情，哪怕它毫无用处。最明显的例子是晚期癌症的治疗。医生们因为无力治愈这种疾病而感到沮丧，又害怕病人失去希望，于是常常采用科学上毫无根据的大胆疗法。

lines: In 1950, the U.S. spent $12.7 billion on health care. In 2002, the cost will be $1,540 billion. Anyone can see this trend is unsustainable. Yet few seem willing to try to reverse it. Some scholars conclude that a government with finite resources should simply stop paying for medical care that sustains life beyond a certain age -- say 83 or so. Former Colorado governor Richard Lamm has been quoted as saying that the old and infirm "have a duty to die and get out of the way" so that younger, healthier people can realize their potential.
1950年，美国在医疗保健方面的开支是127亿美元。2002年，这项开支将达到15,400亿美元。谁都看得出这种趋势难以为继。然而很少有人愿意设法扭转它。一些学者的结论是：资源有限的政府干脆应当停止为维持超过一定年龄——比如说83岁左右——的人的生命支付医疗费用。据说前科罗拉多州州长理查德·拉姆曾说过，年老体弱者“有义务死去并让出位置”，以便更年轻、更健康的人们能够发挥他们的潜能。

lines: I would not go that far. Energetic people now routinely work through their 60s and beyond, and remain dazzlingly productive. At 78, Viacom chairman Sumner Redstone jokingly claims to be 53. Supreme Court Justice Sandra Day O'Connor is in her 70s, and former surgeon general C. Everett Koop chairs an Internet start-up in his 80s. These leaders are living proof that prevention works and that we can manage the health problems that come naturally with age. As a mere 68-year-old, I wish to age as productively as they have.

我不会走得那么远。如今精力充沛的人们通常会一直工作到60多岁甚至更久，而且依然创造力惊人。78岁的维阿康姆公司董事长萨姆纳·雷德斯通开玩笑说自己只有53岁。最高法院法官桑德拉·戴·奥康纳已年逾七旬，前卫生局局长C.埃弗雷特·库普80多岁时还主持着一家互联网初创公司。这些领导者是活生生的证明：预防是有效的，而且我们能够处理随着年龄自然而来的健康问题。我这个“区区”68岁的人，希望自己到了老年也能像他们一样富有效率。

I also know that people in Japan and Sweden, countries that spend far less on medical care, have achieved longer, healthier lives than we have. lines: Teachers need to be aware of the emotional, intellectual, and physical changes that young adults experience. And they also need to give serious **thought** to how they can best **accommodate** such changes. Growing bodies need movement and exercise, but not just in ways that emphasize competition. Although they are adjusting to their new bodies and a whole host of new intellectual and emotional challenges, teenagers are especially self-conscious and need the **confidence** that comes from achieving success and knowing that their accomplishments are **admired** by others. However, the typical teenage lifestyle is already filled with so much competition that it would be **risky** to plan activities in which there are more winners than losers, for example, publishing newsletters with many student-written book reviews, displaying student artwork, and sponsoring book discussion clubs. A variety of small clubs can provide multiple opportunities for leadership, as well as for practice in successful **group** dynamics. Making friends is extremely important to teenagers, and many shy students need the **security** of some kind of organization with a supportive adult barely visible in the background.

教师需要了解青年人所经历的情感、智力和身体上的变化。他们还需要认真思考如何才能最好地适应这些变化。成长中的身体需要运动和锻炼，但不能只通过强调竞争的方式来进行。尽管青少年正在适应身体的变化，以及一系列新的智力和情感挑战，他们仍格外在意别人如何看待自己，需要通过取得成功、知道自己的成就受到他人赞赏来获得自信。然而，青少年通常的生活中已经充满太多竞争，因此，安排一些赢家多于输家的活动将是有风险的，例如出版刊有许多学生书评的通讯、展出学生的艺术作品，以及举办读书讨论社团。各种各样的小型俱乐部能够提供多种锻炼领导才能的机会，也能成功地练习群体相处的技巧。交朋友对青少年来说极为重要，许多腼腆的学生需要某种组织带来的安全感，并且有一名富有支持精神的成年人在幕后几乎不为人见地给予帮助。

lines: In these activities, it is important to remember that young teens have **short** attention spans. A variety of activities should be organized so that participants can remain active as long as they want and then go on to **something** else without feeling guilty and without letting the other participants **down**. This does not mean that adults must accept irresponsibility. **On the contrary**, they can help students acquire a sense of commitment by **planning** for roles that are within their responsibilities and their attention spans and by having clearly stated rules.
在组织这些活动时，必须记住青少年注意力集中的时间很短。应当组织多种多样的活动，以便让参加者能随心所欲地保持活跃，然后转而参加别的活动而不会心怀愧疚，也不会让其他参加者感到失望。这并不意味着成年人必须接受不负责任的态度。恰恰相反，成年人可以通过设计一些处于学生责任范围和注意力范围之内的角色，并通过制定明确无误的规则，来帮助学生培养一种尽职尽责的精神。

lines: Human beings in all times and places think about their world and wonder at their place in it. Humans are thoughtful and creative, possessed of insatiable curiosity. (41) Furthermore, humans have the ability to modify the environment in which they live, thus subjecting all other life forms to their own peculiar ideas and fancies. Therefore, it is important to study humans in all their richness and diversity in a calm and systematic manner, with the hope that the knowledge resulting from such studies can lead humans to a more harmonious way of living with themselves and with all other life forms on this planet Earth.
古往今来，人类都在思考他们所处的世界，并对自己在这个世界中的位置感到好奇。人类既善于思考又富于创造力，具有永不满足的好奇心。（41）而且，人类还有能力改变自己的生存环境，从而让所有其他生命形态都服从于人类自己独特的想法和想象。因此，以冷静而系统的方式研究人类自身的丰富性和多样性十分重要，人们期望这类研究所获得的知识能够促使人类与自身、以及与地球上所有其他生命形态更加和谐地相处。

lines: Anthropological analyses rest heavily upon the concept of culture. Sir Edward Tylor's formulation of the concept of culture was one of the great intellectual achievements of 19th century science. (44) Tylor defined culture as "...that complex whole which includes belief, art, morals, law, custom, and any other capabilities and habits acquired by man as a member of society." This insight, so profound in its simplicity, opened up an entirely new way of perceiving and understanding human life. Implicit within Tylor's definition is the concept that culture is learned, shared, and patterned behavior.
人类学的分析很大程度上依赖于文化这一概念。爱德华·泰勒爵士对文化概念的表述是19世纪科学的伟大思想成就之一。（44）泰勒把文化定义为“……一个复合整体，它包括人作为社会成员所获得的信仰、艺术、道德、法律、风俗以及其他能力和习惯。”这一见解如此简洁却极为深刻，开辟了一条认识和理解人类生活的全新途径。泰勒的定义中还隐含着这样一个观念：文化是习得的、共享的、模式化的行为。

data.title: 温室花朵经不起风雨（The Flower in the Greenhouse Cannot Withstand the Storm）
data.directions_en: Study the following set of drawings carefully and write an essay in which you should 1) describe the set of drawings, interpret its meaning, and 2) point out its implications in our life. You should write about 200 words neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)
data.directions_zh: 仔细观察下面的一组图画，写一篇文章，内容包括：1）描述这组图画并解释其含义；2）指出它对我们生活的启示。应在答题卡2上工整地写约200词。（20分）
sample: The set of drawings above vividly depicts a delicate flower in two entirely different circumstances. In the first drawing, the flower blooms beautifully inside a warm greenhouse, sheltered from thunderstorms and harsh weather. In the second, however, the same flower, once removed from the greenhouse and exposed to wind and rain, quickly withers and dies, while the caption reads: "The flower in the greenhouse cannot withstand the storm."
上面这组图画生动地描绘了一朵娇嫩的花在两种截然不同环境中的遭遇。第一幅图中，这朵花在温暖的温室里开得十分艳丽，免受雷雨和恶劣天气的侵袭。然而在第二幅图中，同一朵花一旦被移出温室、暴露在风雨之中，便迅速凋零枯萎，图下的文字说明写道：“温室里的花朵经不起风雨。”

sample: The drawings intend to reveal a profound truth: overprotection does more harm than good. Like the greenhouse flower, young people brought up under excessive shelter may appear healthy and promising, yet they lack the toughness to cope with setbacks. Once they step into a competitive society filled with storms and stresses, they are apt to break down, because the difficulties of real life can never be blocked out by a glass roof.
这组图画旨在揭示一个深刻的道理：过度保护弊大于利。正如温室里的花朵一样，在过度呵护下成长起来的年轻人也许看似健康、前程似锦，但他们缺乏应对挫折的韧性。一旦踏入充满风雨与压力的竞争社会，他们便容易垮掉，因为现实生活的困难绝不是一层玻璃屋顶就能遮挡得住的。

sample: The implications for our life are far-reaching. Parents and schools should loosen excessive care and give children more opportunities to face difficulties on their own; young people, for their part, should volunteer to brave the elements, treating hardships as the best classroom for growth. Only by experiencing wind and rain outside the greenhouse can the younger generation take root firmly in the soil of society and blossom into true strength of the nation.
这对我们生活的启示是深远的。家长和学校应当放松过度的呵护，给孩子们更多独自面对困难的机会；年轻人自己也应当主动迎接风雨，把磨难当作成长最好的课堂。只有经受住温室之外的日晒雨淋，年轻一代才能在社会土壤中扎根稳固，成长为国家的真正栋梁。
